title: Vertex AI passthrough and proxy routes: VertexAIProvider forwards to the Claude or MaaS delegate instead of GeminiProvider
answers: Why does /gateway/anthropic/v1/messages return 400 for a Claude model hosted on Vertex AI?
Why did a /gateway/proxy/{endpoint}/v1/messages request on a Vertex endpoint go to generativelanguage.googleapis.com?
Why is token usage missing on the span for a streaming Anthropic passthrough to a Vertex Claude endpoint?
Where is the passthrough or proxy handling for Vertex AI Claude and MaaS models?
body:
Path: `mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:VertexAIProvider` receives AI Gateway passthrough requests (`/gateway/anthropic/v1/messages`, `/gateway/openai/v1/chat/completions`, Gemini passthrough) and raw proxy requests (`/gateway/proxy/{endpoint}/...`) for Vertex AI endpoints, and extracts passthrough token usage from non-streaming responses.
Rule: `VertexAIProvider._passthrough`, `_proxy` and `_extract_passthrough_token_usage` forward to `self._delegate` when one exists (Claude or MaaS) and fall back to the Gemini implementation otherwise. `_VertexAIClaudeProvider._passthrough` posts to `{model}:rawPredict` or `:streamRawPredict` with `anthropic_version` in the body and no `model` field, because the inherited `AnthropicProvider._passthrough` posts to `base_url + "messages"` with the model in the body, which Vertex rejects. `_VertexAIClaudeProvider._proxy` maps `v1/messages` (leading slash and query string tolerated) onto those same paths and returns 501 for any other path, since Vertex exposes only the Messages API for Claude. `_VertexAIMaaSProvider` inherits the OpenAI-compatible passthrough, which posts to `_api_base`. Both delegates must be constructed with `enable_tracing` passed through, because `_set_span_token_usage` no-ops when the delegate's own flag is False.
Symptom: Anthropic passthrough on a Claude Vertex endpoint was rejected with 400, and proxy requests were sent to the public Gemini host with a Vertex OAuth token. Streaming passthrough spans on Vertex never received a token usage attribute.
Constraints: Gemini models keep the previous Gemini code path. The MaaS raw proxy still runs through `proxy_root_url()`, which strips the `/openapi` segment; that was left for a separate change. Non-`v1/messages` proxy paths on Claude return 501 by design, not a bug.
applies: Vertex AI gateway endpoints serving passthrough or proxy routes for Claude or MaaS models.
says: Claude passthrough requests through the gateway fail with invalid request errors.
Proxy requests for partner models are incorrectly routed to public endpoints instead.
Streaming responses through gateway passthrough are missing token usage metrics in traces.
Routing Claude messages through the gateway endpoint sends requests to the wrong provider.
Enable token usage tracking on streaming passthrough spans for Vertex hosted models.
search: VertexAIProvider in mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py forwards _passthrough, _proxy, and _extract_passthrough_token_usage to self._delegate (_VertexAIClaudeProvider or _VertexAIMaaSProvider) with enable_tracing passed through so streaming spans capture token usage attributes. _VertexAIClaudeProvider._passthrough targets {model}:rawPredict or :streamRawPredict with anthropic_version and no model field, while its proxy route maps v1/messages and returns 501 for other paths. This applies to Vertex AI Claude and MaaS passthrough and proxy routes, while Gemini models retain the fallback GeminiProvider path.
